TABLE.NAME: local_quizbot_job
TABLE.COMMENT: One run of the Quizbot wizard for one quiz: what the teacher chose, and later the questions written for it.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who started it

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id of the quiz

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: draft, running, review, saved, discarded

FIELD.NAME: remedial
FIELD.COMMENT: For a remedial quiz: the key shared by the runs made together from one quiz's analysis; empty for the wizard

FIELD.NAME: remoteid
FIELD.COMMENT: The id of this request at the Quizbot service

FIELD.NAME: sources
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: chosen course items, link, pasted text

FIELD.NAME: options
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: numbers per question type, language, level

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: the questions returned, until they are saved or discarded

TABLE.NAME: local_quizbot_question
TABLE.COMMENT: A question added with Quizbot: the Moodle question it became, and what Quizbot found out about it (topic, Bloom's level, difficulty), for Quizbot Analysis. Kept while the question is in a question bank.

FIELD.NAME: questionbankentryid
FIELD.COMMENT: The question, whatever versions it gets later

FIELD.NAME: questionid
FIELD.COMMENT: The version Quizbot added

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The quiz it was written for

FIELD.NAME: jobid
FIELD.COMMENT: The wizard run it came from; runs are removed a week after saving

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who added it; 0 once that is deleted for privacy

FIELD.NAME: qtype
FIELD.COMMENT: multichoice, truefalse, shortanswer, numerical, match or essay

FIELD.NAME: sourcename
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the material it was written from

FIELD.NAME: sourcecmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course item that material is, so students can be sent back to it; 0 when it is not one

FIELD.NAME: topic
FIELD.COMMENT: A short name of the topic it tests

FIELD.NAME: bloom
FIELD.COMMENT: remember, understand, apply, analyse, evaluate or create

FIELD.NAME: difficulty
FIELD.COMMENT: easy, medium or hard

FIELD.NAME: edited
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = the teacher changed it before adding it

FIELD.NAME: rewritten
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = written anew at the teacher's request

TABLE.NAME: local_quizbot_remedial
TABLE.COMMENT: A remedial quiz made with Quizbot for students below the pass mark of another quiz, so that Quizbot Analysis can show how it went. Kept while the remedial quiz exists.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The quiz whose analysis it was made from

FIELD.NAME: quizcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The remedial quiz

FIELD.NAME: groupid
FIELD.COMMENT: The group that may see it

FIELD.NAME: topic
FIELD.COMMENT: The topic it revises, as Quizbot Analysis names it

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The teacher who made it; 0 once that is deleted for privacy
